subject: Request: co-sell marketplace discount exception for EdgeScale (private offer)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: co-sell marketplace discount exception for EdgeScale (private offer)

Team —

Quick summary: EdgeScale (enterprise analytics vendor) is ready to purchase but procurement is pushing for a 25% discount on the AWS private offer listing to match their procurement thresholds. This is a $360k first-year ARR commit on a 12-month term (list annual value = $480k). They will sign a private offer through AWS and want Redwood to appear as the seller with co-sell engagement.

Why this matters: EdgeScale is a strategic co-sell account (they run in AWS, strong reference potential, and the AWS AM is engaged). If we don't move quickly on pricing, the customer will delay by multiple quarters. Sales requests a marketplace private-offer discount exception to close by 2026-07-22.

Ask:
- Approve a 25% off list price on the AWS private offer for year 1 (one-year term), with a standard renewal back to list thereafter.
- Confirm whether Redwood will cover seller/partner fees or if AWS will remit partner incentives (we need guidance for the marketplace entry).

Attachments: edgescale_quote_v1.pdf (PDF), partner_co-sell_package.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Key contacts on the thread: Jane Foster (Procurement, EdgeScale) — procurement email attached. AWS AM is copied separately (aws-mp-rep@amazon.com).

Time is the constraint — procurement asked for a signed private offer by end-of-week. Can we get a quick decision or an interim approval to offer 20% while we finalize co-sell registration?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.inference.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell marketplace discount exception for EdgeScale (private offer)

Alex — thanks for the context and attachments. A few clarifying items we need before a full exception sign-off:

1) Final TCV and list price confirmation (you mentioned $480k list annual value, confirm exact SKU lines).
2) Expected margin after proposed discount (need to confirm we meet minimum gross margin for exception).
3) AWS co-sell registration status (is the partner registration submitted? AM LOA or AWS co-sell case id?).
4) Customer LOA or a procurement email confirming private-offer path.

Conditional response: I can provisionally approve a maximum of 15% off list for year 1 provided:
- Sales completes the pricing exception form (see link below) and returns it signed.
- AWS co-sell is registered and we have the AWS AM on record.
- Legal confirms standard marketplace terms are acceptable to EdgeScale (cc'ing Laura).

Notes on marketplace economics: AWS typically expects partners to absorb marketplace seller fees or pass them through. We can cover up to an 8% rebate in lieu of partner fees for this one-off. Anything beyond that requires Revenue Management approval.

Please complete the pricing exception form and attach the signed LOA from EdgeScale. I'll expedite review once those items are in.

Pricing exception form (internal): https://redwood.internal/pricing-exceptions/form
DocuSign template (private offer): https://www.docusign.net/EDGE-RDW-4532

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Deal Desk Lead
rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com

Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell marketplace discount exception for EdgeScale (private offer)

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick reply. Answers below and attached: pricing_exception_form_filled.pdf (signed by me).

- Confirmed SKU lines and list: see attached quote (edgescale_quote_v1.pdf) — List annual = $480,000; first-year ARR requested = $360,000 after 25% off.
- Margin at 20% discount = ~28% gross margin; at 15% discount = ~34% gross margin. We can hit your 15% threshold easily; 20% is tighter but still workable for a one-year concession.
- AWS co-sell: registration in progress; AWS AM (aws-mp-rep@amazon.com) is engaged and has verbally confirmed intent to co-sell — case id pending.
- LOA: Jane Foster (procurement) has provided an email confirming private-offer route; forwarded in attached PDF (procurement email excerpt).

Given procurement pressure, would you consider approving 20% one-time concession for year 1 if we commit to standard renewal at list and include a customer reference clause? This gets the deal closed this week.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5283921

Attachments: pricing_exception_form_filled.pdf

Appreciate the expedited review.

—Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell marketplace discount exception for EdgeScale (private offer)

Folks —

I reviewed the materials quickly (thanks Alex) and agree with a time-limited concession to keep momentum. Approval: Redwood will allow up to a 20% discount off list for year 1 on the AWS private offer, with the following conditions:

- This is a one-time concession limited to the first 12-month term only; renewals revert to list pricing unless a new exception is approved.
- Sales must secure a signed LOA from the AWS AM confirming co-sell engagement prior to DocuSign execution.
- EdgeScale must agree to be a reference customer and approve a short (1 page) case study within 6 months.
- Legal (Laura) to confirm there are no non-standard clauses in the private-offer DocuSign prior to signature.

Rishi — please prepare the approval memo and record the exception in the pricing-exceptions tracker (use deal id RDW-2026-ES-4132). Alex — proceed to finalize the private offer with the AWS AM once the LOA is attached and legal signs off.

If the AWS AM cannot provide an LOA by EOD Monday (07/20) escalate back to me.

Monica Patel
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.inference.com
